questions.question: Which of the following equations is correct by interchanging the '+' and '×' signs and the '4' and '5' numbers?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

Given interchanges:

__
 
• Signs: '+' and '×' are interchanged.
 
• Numbers: '4' and '5' are interchanged.

**1) 20 + 5 × 4 = 85**

Applying interchanges: 20 × 4 + 5 = ?

⇒ **20 × 4**__ + 5

⇒ __**80 + 5**__

⇒ 85

85 = 85 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

392 × 7 − 2 ÷ 12 + 80 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

392 × 7 − 2 ÷ 12 + 80 = ?

Replace the operators with their corresponding new meanings:

392 ÷ 7 + 2 × 12 − 80 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= **392 ÷ 7**__ + __**2 × 12**__ − 80

= __**56 + 24**__ − 80

= __**80 − 80**__

= 0

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
4 is related to 70 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 8 is related to 518. To which of the following is 6 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number³ + 6 = 2nd number.**

4 is related to 70

→ 4³ + 6

→ 64 + 6

→ 70 = 2nd number

8 is related to 518

→ 8³ + 6

→ 512 + 6

→ 518 = 2nd number

6 is related to 

→ 6³ + 6

→ 216 + 6

**→ 222 = 2nd number**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Exactly three people are sitting between E and B when counted from the right of E. Both G and D are immediate neighbours of F. C is sitting to the immediate left of A. D and E are not sitting next to each other. The position of how many persons will remain unchanged, excluding A, if all the persons are arranged in the English alphabetical order, in clockwise direction, starting from A?
questions.solution:
Given:

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Exactly three people are sitting between E and B when counted from the right of E.

Both G and D are immediate neighbours of F. C is sitting to the immediate left of A.

D and E are not sitting next to each other. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e16d9d4ee1d62c14ca12de5ea705c5f3666273f8e24534a5d3a7b33778e8c486.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6042b87f46683e724f556bc76409eded5deccc86b5828f68f9a1a98b095d3b22.png] 

All the persons are arranged in the English alphabetical order, in clockwise direction, starting from A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ccb498de0f7416686d776dd240b5b9f4635290ee4ec8ae54a03b944cda17070.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46ad8358a33ebf348354502457557ce411ad4e315f6b0f7d4b166e54d6c55dbe.png] 

Only the position of D will remain unchanged.

Thus, only 1 person remain unchanged.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered 1, and 2. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No Doctor is a Nurse

Some Nurses are Patients

Some Patients are Medicines

Conclusions:

1. Some Patients are not Doctors

2. Some Nurses are Medicines
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec4595506955a96202deb5c4bb3b76502eaf45ad09c84039a0db08754e974b4d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b39d4cb7e992fb45456314788dd638ff6ce649e1a2d9de8ee70bb99d1535acc.png] 

**Conclusions:**

1. Some Patients are not Doctors → **True **( As, No Doctor is a Nurse and Some Nurses are Patients. so, Some Patients are not Doctors holds true)

2. Some Nurses are Medicines → False ( As, there is no direct relation between Nurses and Medicines)

Thus, Only conclusion 1 follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
19 is related to 39 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 1 is related to 3. To which of the following is 3 related following the same logic?

NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number × 2 + 1 = 2nd number.**

19 is related to 39

→ 19 × 2 + 1

→ 38 + 1

→ 39 = 2nd number

1 is related to 3
